description: Fixture-driven trust substrate: Matters (Folders), PDF viewer, locked citations, click-to-highlight evidence, fail-closed export gating, and minimal provenance export.

userStories.title: Matter baseline (Folder CRUD + detail surface)
userStories.description: Create and open a Matter (Folder) to review evidence: Matter list/detail with document list and seeded report table.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001 I can create a Matter (folder) and see it in a Matter list.
AC-002 I can open a Matter detail page that shows a document list and a seeded report table.

userStories.title: Upload PDFs and show ingest status
userStories.description: Upload PDFs into a Matter and show them in a document list with ingest status and basic quality metadata fields (even if stubbed).
acceptanceCriteria: AC-003 I can upload a PDF into a Matter and see it appear in the document list.
AC-004 The document list shows ingest status and basic quality metadata fields (even if stubbed).

userStories.title: View a PDF (page nav + zoom) via render contract
userStories.description: Provide a reliable PDF viewer with page navigation and zoom that fetches a render_url via GET /documents/:id/render?page=N.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-005 Viewer renders the correct PDF and can navigate to any page.
AC-006 Zoom controls re-render consistently (no CSS-scaling drift) and the viewer stays responsive on pack_07 scans.
AC-007 Viewer obtains render_url via GET /documents/:id/render?page=N (server contract, 1-indexed page) rather than hardcoding storage paths.

userStories.title: Locked citation object + hashing contract
userStories.description: Treat citations as immutable, locked objects addressable by citation_id with snippet + snippet_hash and polygons; ensure snippet_hash is stable via canonical normalization.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-009 snippet_hash uses canonical normalisation rules (single implementation reused everywhere) and is stable across repeated processing.

userStories.title: Citation chip -> jump-to-highlight (anchors-first, fail-closed)
userStories.description: Clicking a citation chip opens the viewer at the correct document/page and renders a verified highlight overlay (anchors-first) with explicit fail-closed behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-010 Clicking a citation chip opens the viewer at the correct document + page.
AC-011 Highlight overlay maps locked polygons to viewport CSS pixels correctly at 50/100/150% zoom (or the UI explicitly enforces the chosen honest fallback).
AC-012 On rotated/scanned pages (pack_07), highlight remains aligned (or the UI explicitly enforces the chosen honest fallback).
AC-013 If citation invariants fail (doc mismatch, invalid polygons, wrong page, snippet_hash mismatch), the UI renders no overlay and shows explicit citation_failed details.

userStories.title: Row status machine + export gate (fail closed)
userStories.description: Report rows have terminal statuses and exports are blocked when evidence fails so we never ship untrusted output.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-014 Rows can be in terminal statuses: needs_review|reviewed|missing_input|citation_failed and statuses are visible in the report table.
AC-015 One deliberate bad citation produces citation_failed and export is blocked by default when any row is citation_failed.

userStories.title: Failure journeys + provenance export
userStories.description: Missing-doc and citation failure states are actionable, and a minimal run trace JSON can be exported for debugging with safe redaction defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-016 In pack_02_missing_rea, rows that depend on missing docs are missing_input and show an actionable missing-doc checklist.
AC-016a missing_input rows use the exact answer string Not found in provided documents. and have zero citations.
AC-017 The UI can export a minimal run trace JSON (developer-facing) with safe redaction defaults (opaque IDs + hashes, no raw provider payloads).
AC-018 Flag citation wrong action logs a safe feedback event with citation_id + reason code.
